      paste0("Raw Lambda coordinate ", i),
      "gray50"
    )
    qqplot_standard_normal(
      x[, paste0("debiased_lambda_", i)],
      paste0("Debiased Lambda coordinate ", i),
      "darkgreen"
    )
  }
  qqplot_chisq(
    x[, "chi_sq_debiased_lambda"], d,
    paste0("Debiased Lambda chi-square, df=", d)
  )
  invisible(NULL)
}

# Report statuses for all attempts, then mean and sample SD for each
# component among successful replications. Joint coverage is the fraction
# of squared-norm statistics below the corresponding 95% chi-square cutoff.
print_simulation_summary <- function(results, config) {
  k <- config$k
  d <- k * (k + 1L) / 2L
  code_labels <- c(
    `0` = "converged", `1` = "maximum_iterations",
    `2` = "non_finite", `3` = "error"
  )
  cat("\n================ Simulation Summary ================\n")
  cat("Model:", config$model, "\n")
  cat("Learning rate:", config$learning_rate,
      " Max iterations:", config$max_iter,
      " Tolerance:", config$tolerance, "\n")
  cat(paste0(
    "Convergence metric: max(||Delta_U||_max/(learning_rate/n), ",
    "||Delta_lambda_v||_inf/(learning_rate/(2*n^2)))\n"
  ))
  cat("\nConvergence:\n")
  print(table(code_labels[as.character(results[, "convergence_code"])],
              useNA = "ifany"))

  finite_projection_rows <- which(is.finite(results[, "projection_calls"]))
  if (length(finite_projection_rows)) {
    projection_results <- results[finite_projection_rows, , drop = FALSE]
    cat(sprintf(
      paste0(
        "Certified C_U projection diagnostics: max row ratio=%.6f; ",
        "minimum row margin=%.4e; max Gram error=%.4e; ",
        "max polar objective gap=%.4e\n"
      ),
      max(projection_results[, "projection_max_row_ratio"]),
      min(projection_results[, "projection_min_row_margin"]),
      max(projection_results[, "projection_max_gram_error"]),
      max(projection_results[, "projection_max_objective_gap"])
    ))
  }

  rows <- inference_rows(results, converged_only = TRUE)
  cat("Converged replications used for inference:", length(rows), "\n")
  if (!length(rows)) return(invisible(NULL))
  x <- results[rows, , drop = FALSE]

  cat(sprintf(
    paste0(
      "D_UG/P_UU diagnostics: median Gram error from nI=%.4e; ",
      "maximum Gram condition number=%.4e; maximum P_UU idempotence ",
      "error=%.4e; maximum P_UU D_UG error=%.4e\n"
    ),
    median(x[, "DUG_gram_error_from_nI"], na.rm = TRUE),
    max(x[, "DUG_gram_condition_number"], na.rm = TRUE),
    max(x[, "PUU_idempotence_error"], na.rm = TRUE),
    max(x[, "PUU_DUG_annihilation_error"], na.rm = TRUE)
  ))

  cat("\nNode U standardized statistics:\n")
  for (i in seq_len(k)) {
    z <- finite_values(x[, paste0("stat_U_", i)])
    cat(sprintf(" U%d: mean=%.4f, sd=%.4f\n", i, mean(z), sd(z)))
  }
  cat("\nLambda standardized statistics:\n")
  for (i in seq_len(d)) {
    z <- finite_values(x[, paste0("debiased_lambda_", i)])
    cat(sprintf(" Lambda %d: mean=%.4f, sd=%.4f\n", i, mean(z), sd(z)))
  }
  cat(sprintf(
    "\nNode chi-square: mean=%.4f, 95%% coverage=%.4f\n",
    mean(x[, "chi_sq_U"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(x[, "chi_sq_U"] <= qchisq(0.95, k), na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "Lambda chi-square: mean=%.4f, 95%% coverage=%.4f\n",
    mean(x[, "chi_sq_debiased_lambda"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(
      x[, "chi_sq_debiased_lambda"] <= qchisq(0.95, d),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0(
      "Alignment: min singular value median=%.4f; ",
      "condition number median=%.4f\n"
    ),
    median(x[, "alignment_min_singular_value"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median(x[, "alignment_condition_number"], na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "max_abs_BM: median=%.4g, maximum=%.4g%s\n",
    median(x[, "max_abs_BM"], na.rm = TRUE),
    max(x[, "max_abs_BM"], na.rm = TRUE),
    if (config$model == "bernoulli_probit") {
      " (generally nonzero for probit)"
    } else ""
  ))
  cat("====================================================\n")
  invisible(NULL)
}

# Encode one finite numeric setting as a compact filename-safe tag.
number_tag <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) != 1L || !is.finite(x)) {
    stop("number_tag requires one finite number.")
  }
  tag <- sprintf("%.8g", as.numeric(x))
  tag <- gsub("-", "m", tag, fixed = TRUE)
  tag <- gsub("+", "", tag, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(".", "p", tag, fixed = TRUE)
}

# Label a numeric vector with readable values plus a digest of its RDS encoding.
numeric_vector_tag <- function(x, readable_limit = 6L) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  if (!length(x) || any(!is.finite(x))) {
    stop("numeric_vector_tag requires a nonempty finite numeric vector.")
  }
  temporary_path <- tempfile("gfm_numeric_vector_", fileext = ".rds")
  on.exit(unlink(temporary_path), add = TRUE)
  saveRDS(x, temporary_path, version = 2)
  hash <- substr(unname(tools::md5sum(temporary_path)), 1L, 12L)
  readable <- if (length(x) <= readable_limit) {
    paste(vapply(x, number_tag, character(1L)), collapse = "_")
  } else {
    paste0("length", length(x))
  }
  paste0(readable, "_h", hash)
}

# Save the full result table (including failures) as CSV, plus RDS files
# for results with attributes, truth, configuration, and execution settings.
# CSV does not retain R attributes: keep its configuration when sharing it.
# Write QQ plots from successful replications when any are available.
save_outputs <- function(results, config, output_dir) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  lambda_tag <- numeric_vector_tag(config$lambda_vec)
  prefix <- paste0(
    config$output_prefix,
    "_ball_rejection_no_centering",
    "_n", config$n,
    "_k", config$k,
    "_lambda_", lambda_tag,
    "_R", config$n_sim,
    "_target", config$target_node,
    "_dseed", config$design_seed,
    "_rseed", config$replication_seed_base,
    "_sig", number_tag(config$sigma),
    "_lr", number_tag(config$learning_rate),
    "_iter", config$max_iter,
    "_tol", number_tag(config$tolerance),
    "_MU", number_tag(config$M_bound_U),
    "_ML", number_tag(config$M_bound_Lambda),
    "_peps", number_tag(config$probability_eps),
    "_weps", number_tag(config$whitening_eigen_floor)
  )
  csv_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_results.csv"))
  rds_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_complete.rds"))
  truth_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_truth.rds"))
  config_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_config.rds"))
  settings_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_settings.rds"))
  plot_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_qqplots.pdf"))

  write.csv(as.data.frame(results), csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
  saveRDS(results, rds_path)
  saveRDS(attr(results, "truth"), truth_path)
  saveRDS(config, config_path)
  saveRDS(attr(results, "settings"), settings_path)

  converged <- inference_rows(results, converged_only = TRUE)
  if (length(converged)) {
    pdf(plot_path, width = 11, height = 7)
    plot_results(results, config, converged_only = TRUE)
    dev.off()
  } else {
    # Do not leave a same-configuration PDF from an earlier run in place.
    if (file.exists(plot_path)) file.remove(plot_path)
    warning("No QQ plot written because no replication converged.")
    plot_path <- NA_character_
  }

  cat("Outputs saved in:", normalizePath(output_dir), "\n")
  invisible(list(
    csv = csv_path, rds = rds_path, truth = truth_path,
    config = config_path, settings = settings_path, plots = plot_path
  ))
}

# ----------------------- Model selection ------------------------

# Change params$model in the YAML header, or render with, e.g.:
# rmarkdown::render(
#   "node_inference.Rmd", # Run this example from the simulations/ directory.
#   params = list(
#     model = "poisson", n = 300, n_sim = 100, k = 3, target_node = 1,
#     lambda_values = "0.30, 0.25, 0.20",
#     run_simulation = TRUE
#   )
# )

requested_key <- tolower(gsub("[- ]", "_", runtime_params$model))
selected_models <- if (requested_key %in% c("all", "all_models")) {
  c("gaussian", "poisson", "bernoulli_logit", "bernoulli_probit")
} else {
  normalize_model_name(runtime_params$model)
}

# Translate non-NULL render parameters into validated model-configuration inputs.
make_param_overrides <- function(base_config, params) {
  overrides <- list()
  latent <- resolve_latent_parameters(
    base_config = base_config,
    k_value = params$k,
    lambda_values = params$lambda_values
  )
  overrides$k <- latent$k
  overrides$lambda_vec <- latent$lambda_vec
  if (!is.null(params$n)) overrides$n <- as.numeric(params$n)
  if (!is.null(params$n_sim)) overrides$n_sim <- as.numeric(params$n_sim)
  if (!is.null(params$design_seed)) {
    overrides$design_seed <- as.numeric(params$design_seed)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$replication_seed_base)) {
    overrides$replication_seed_base <-
      as.numeric(params$replication_seed_base)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$target_node)) {
    overrides$target_node <- as.numeric(params$target_node)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$sigma)) overrides$sigma <- as.numeric(params$sigma)
  if (!is.null(params$learning_rate)) {
    overrides$learning_rate <- as.numeric(params$learning_rate)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$max_iter)) {
    overrides$max_iter <- as.numeric(params$max_iter)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$tolerance)) {
    overrides$tolerance <- as.numeric(params$tolerance)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$M_bound_U)) {
    overrides$M_bound_U <- as.numeric(params$M_bound_U)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$M_bound_Lambda)) {
    overrides$M_bound_Lambda <- as.numeric(params$M_bound_Lambda)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$probability_eps)) {
    overrides$probability_eps <- as.numeric(params$probability_eps)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$probability_floor)) {
    overrides$probability_floor <- as.numeric(params$probability_floor)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$curvature_floor)) {
    overrides$curvature_floor <- as.numeric(params$curvature_floor)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$node_information_floor)) {
    overrides$node_information_floor <-
      as.numeric(params$node_information_floor)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$whitening_eigen_floor)) {
    overrides$whitening_eigen_floor <-
      as.numeric(params$whitening_eigen_floor)
  }
  if (!is.null(params$truth_check_action)) {
    overrides$truth_check_action <- as.character(params$truth_check_action)
  }
  overrides
}

requested_cores <- if (is.null(runtime_params$n_cores)) {
  NULL
} else {
  as.numeric(runtime_params$n_cores)
}
if (!is.null(requested_cores) &&
    (length(requested_cores) != 1L || !is.finite(requested_cores) ||
     requested_cores < 1L || requested_cores != floor(requested_cores))) {
  stop("n_cores must be a positive integer.")
}
if (!is.null(requested_cores)) requested_cores <- as.integer(requested_cores)

root_output_dir <- runtime_params$output_dir
if (is.null(root_output_dir)) {
  root_output_dir <- "../data/node1/new_run"
} else if (length(root_output_dir) != 1L ||
           !is.character(root_output_dir) || !nzchar(root_output_dir)) {
  stop("output_dir must be NULL or one nonempty character string.")
}

results_by_model <- list()
truth_by_model <- list()
output_files_by_model <- list()

# Build and check every requested truth before starting any expensive model.
# This prevents model="all" from completing several simulations before a
# later model reports an invalid probability/curvature range.
configs_by_model <- setNames(lapply(selected_models, function(selected_model) {
  base_config <- default_model_configs()[[selected_model]]
  overrides <- make_param_overrides(base_config, runtime_params)
  get_model_config(selected_model, overrides)
}), selected_models)

preflight_truths <- lapply(configs_by_model, generate_truth)
if (length(preflight_truths) > 1L) {
  reference_U <- preflight_truths[[1L]]$U_star
  maximum_common_U_difference <- max(vapply(
    preflight_truths[-1L],
    function(truth) {
      if (!identical(dim(truth$U_star), dim(reference_U))) return(Inf)
      max(abs(truth$U_star - reference_U))
    },
    numeric(1L)
  ))
  if (!is.finite(maximum_common_U_difference) ||
      maximum_common_U_difference > 1e-12) {
    stop("The requested models did not receive the same fixed U_star.")
  }
  cat(sprintf(
    "\nCommon-U preflight passed across %d models (max difference %.3e).\n",
    length(preflight_truths), maximum_common_U_difference
  ))
}

for (selected_model in selected_models) {
  config <- configs_by_model[[selected_model]]
  truth <- preflight_truths[[selected_model]]

  cat("\nSelected model:", config$model, "\n")
  cat(
    "n:", config$n, " k:", config$k,
    " Monte Carlo replications:", config$n_sim, "\n"
  )
  cat("Lambda diagonal:", paste(config$lambda_vec, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Learning rate:", config$learning_rate,
      " Maximum iterations:", config$max_iter,
      " Tolerance:", config$tolerance, "\n")

  # false runs the truth checks above only; it does not read saved CSVs,
  # start Monte Carlo workers, or call save_outputs().
  if (isTRUE(runtime_params$run_simulation)) {
    results <- run_monte_carlo(
      config, n_cores = requested_cores, truth = truth
    )
    print_simulation_summary(results, config)
    model_output_dir <- if (length(selected_models) > 1L) {
      file.path(root_output_dir, sub("^bernoulli_", "", config$model))
    } else {
      root_output_dir
    }
    output_files <- save_outputs(results, config, model_output_dir)
    results_by_model[[config$model]] <- results
    truth_by_model[[config$model]] <- attr(results, "truth")
    output_files_by_model[[config$model]] <- output_files
  } else {
    print_truth_diagnostics(truth$diagnostics)
    truth_by_model[[config$model]] <- truth
  }
}
